exposure: history of solid organ transplant (kidney, liver, or heart)
outcome: individual indicators of SMM (pulmonary edema/acute heart failure, acute renal failure)
cohort: Patients aged 12-55 years who underwent a single solid organ transplant prior to pregnancy, had no prior history of transplant rejection, and subsequently experienced a pregnancy.
finding: Solid organ transplant recipients have significantly higher odds of composite SMM compared to pregnant non-transplant recipients, with heart transplant recipients exhibiting the highest prevalence of composite SMM and transplant rejection 5 years post-delivery.
